field.name: body_html
field.p: I would like to apply for leave from to to attend an important event. I would be grateful for your understanding and cooperation in this matter

During my absence, I will ensure that all my pending tasks are completed and/or assigned to ensure proper workflow and am available for any discussions before my leave starts. I am also ready to provide any necessary assistance in preparing for my absence and ensuring my responsibilities are covered during this period.
Thank you for considering my request.

field.name: body_html
field.p: I’m happy to inform you that your leave request has been accepted. Your vacation from to has been approved and wish you a relaxing and enjoyable vacation

Please finish any outstanding duties and explain your handover plan to your team before departing. If any work-related crises develop or urgent concerns need to be addressed while you are away, please notify at /.
Remember, we eagerly await your return, enjoy, rejuvenated and ready to contribute.

field.name: body_html
field.p: I’m afraid to inform you that your recent leave request from to has been denied. After reviewing your request, we have determined that it would not be possible to accommodate your request at this time.

During the time you requested your leave of absence, our company has received multiple requests from our clients which has to be responded instantly. It would just not be practical for us to give up one of our best team member during this time.
I strongly suggest you resubmit your request, after two weeks’ time, I'm happy to accept your request. Thank you so much for your patience concerning my reply.
